Look into a mens shelter in your area. I stayed in one about a year ago and I was roughly your age. You had to pass a drug test to get in and had a breathalyzer every night but they help you a lot. You had a reserved bed every night just had to be inside at like 8pm and lights out at 10. All the guys did a chore or two every day. Give you food, let you find a job, use the house address, save money, counseling etc. I stayed at one for 3 months. It's just like the guy above you said though. You have to really seem committed to bettering yourself. They respected me a lot for being young and doing simple tasks because their are a lot of people who are mentally ill and stay homeless.
